title: Cross-channel timing rotations and asset ownership matrix for Q2 feature release
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Purpose: establish a compact, repeatable schedule (timing rotations) and a single ownership matrix for all customer-facing assets for the upcoming Q2 feature release. Scope: blog, release notes, product email, targeted account emails, social (Twitter/LinkedIn/X), webinar (product demo + Q&A), support KB article, SDK changelog, and localized translations. Out of scope: paid social campaigns and sales enablement long-reads (handled by Growth and Sales respectively).

Objectives:
- Reduce cross-team ambiguity by assigning a single owner and a backup owner for each asset.
- Define send/publish windows to avoid channel collisions and ensure consistent messaging.
- Lock content freeze and translation lead times to meet localization SLAs.
- Coordinate an internal review cadence and sign-off checklist (PM, Legal, Security, Design, Docs, Marketing).

Risks:
- Late engineering API changes could require rollback of published release notes/email content.
- Translations missing due to compressed schedule.

Mitigations:
- Daily triage channel during freeze window.
- Reserve a one-day emergency hold for email sends to apply fixes.
- Canary publish of blog + isolated social thread for rapid edits.
acceptance_criteria: Single asset matrix completed with primary + backup owners for every customer-facing artifact
Content freeze date communicated to engineering and translations teams (see timeline)
Release notes draft published in Drive and linked from release ticket
All assets have a QA checklist completed and approvals from PM, Legal, and Security
Publish windows scheduled in Marketing calendar and integrated with console feature flags for rollout
